name: io.github.yonilev2003/locusfiles
title: Locus
description: Search folders on your own computer from an MCP client; every result carries its file path.

runtimeArguments.name: --with
runtimeArguments.description: Adds the on-device ONNX embedder (the package's `local` extra) to the uvx environment.
